47:1: As for those who disbelieve and prevent from the way of Allah, Allah has rendered their deeds void.
47:2: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been revealed to Muhammad—and it is the truth from their Rabb—Allah has covered their evils and reformed their condition.
47:3: This is undoubtedly because those who disbelieve follow falsehood and those who believe follow the truth from their Rabb. Thus Allah presents to people their examples.
47:4: When you meet those who disbelieve, strike their necks; finally, when you have thoroughly weakened them, bind the bonds firmly. Then either release them with grace or take ransom, until war lays down its burdens. Thus it is. Had Allah willed, He would have taken vengeance on them, but it is to test you with one another. And those who are killed in the way of Allah, He will never render their deeds void.
47:5: He will guide them and set right their condition.
47:6: And He puts them into the Paradise that He made known to them.
47:7: O you who believe, if you help Allah, He will help you and make your feet firm.
47:8: As for those who disbelieve, for them is destruction, and He makes their deeds go astray.
47:9: This is so because they disliked what Allah revealed, so He rendered their deeds void.
47:10: Do they not travel upon the earth and see how the end of those before them was? Allah destroyed them utterly. And for the disbelievers there are the like of it.
47:11: This is so because Allah is the Mawla of those who believe, and the disbelievers have no Mawla.
47:12: Undoubtedly, Allah admits those who believe and do righteous deeds into gardens beneath which rivers flow; as for those who disbelieve, they enjoy themselves and eat as cattle eat, and the Fire will be their dwelling place.
47:13: And how many a city stronger than your city which drove you out have We destroyed, and there was no helper for them.
47:14: Is one who is upon a clear proof from his Rabb like one to whom his evil deed was made alluring and who follows his desires?
47:15: The example of the Paradise promised to the possessors of taqwa: In it are rivers of uncorrupted water, rivers of milk whose taste has not changed, rivers of wine delicious for those who drink, and rivers of strained honey. And for them therein are all kinds of fruit and forgiveness from their Rabb. Is it like one who abides eternally in the Fire and is made to drink boiling water that tears their intestines to pieces?
47:16: And among them are those who listen to you. When they go out from your presence, they say to those who have been given knowledge: "What did he say just now?" Those are the ones whose hearts Allah has sealed and who follow their desires.
47:17: And to those who are guided, He increased guidance for them and gave them their taqwa.
47:18: Do they await anything other than the Hour coming upon them suddenly? Indeed, its signs have already come.
47:19: Know that there is no god but Allah. Ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and the believing women. Allah knows the place where you turn and move about and your resting place.
47:20: And those who believe say: "If only a surah had been revealed!" But when a decisive surah is revealed and fighting is mentioned in it, you see those in whose hearts is a disease looking at you like the look of one fainting from death. So woe to them.
47:21: Obedience and a good word. When the matter is decided, if they had been true to Allah, it would have been better for them.
47:22: So, if you turn away, is it to be expected of you that you cause corruption in the earth and sever your ties of kinship?
47:23: Those are the ones whom Allah has cursed, so He made them deaf and blinded their eyes.
47:24: Do they not ponder the Quran? Or are there locks upon their hearts?
47:25: Undoubtedly, those who turned their backs after guidance had become clear to them, Satan has enticed them and given them hope.
47:26: This is because they said to those who dislike what Allah revealed: 'We will obey you in some matters.' And Allah knows what they conceal.
47:27: Then how will it be when the angels take them in death, striking their faces and their backs?
47:28: This is because they followed what angered Allah and disliked His good pleasure; therefore Allah rendered their deeds void.
47:29: Or did those in whose hearts is a disease think that Allah would never bring out their grudges?
47:30: If We had willed, We would surely have shown them to you and you would have recognized them by their faces; and you will surely recognize them by the tone of speech.
47:31: And We will surely test you until We know those among you who strive and those who are patient, and We will make known your news.
47:32: Undoubtedly, those who disbelieved, prevented from the way of Allah, and opposed the Messenger after guidance had become clearly apparent to them, will not harm Allah in anything, and He will render their deeds void.
47:33: O you who believe, obey Allah and obey the Messenger, and do not render your deeds void.
47:34: Undoubtedly, those who disbelieved and prevented from the way of Allah, then died as disbelievers, Allah will never forgive them.
47:35: So do not weaken and do not call for peace; you are the superior ones, and Allah is with you, and He will never deprive you of your deeds.
47:36: The worldly life is only play and amusement; and if you believe and fear (Allah), He brings you your rewards and does not ask of you your wealth.
47:37: If He were to ask it of you and press you, you would show stinginess, and He would bring out your grudges.
47:38: Here you are, being called to spend in the way of Allah. Some among you show stinginess. And whoever shows stinginess, is stingy only against his own soul. Allah is free of all need, and you are the poor. If you turn away, He will replace you with another people, then they will not be like you.
